events.title: The Cracked Porcelain Plate
events.prose: Maren left a single, chipped saucer on the counter without saying a word. She watched Vera scrub the grease from it for ten minutes before walking out into the heat.

events.title: A Broken Circuit Board
events.prose: Silas pulled a blackened transistor from the machine and tossed it into the sand. He looked at the horizon as if waiting for a signal that never came.

events.title: Unfinished Debt at Midnight
events.prose: Elias counted a stack of crumpled credits and shoved them toward Bastian. Neither man met the other's eyes, leaving the true cost of the transaction hanging in the air.

events.title: The Unspoken Apology
events.prose: Maren sat in the corner booth of the lounge, nursing a lukewarm coffee. She opened her mouth to speak to Vera, but the words dissolved into the hum of the neon signs.

memories.text: Elias watched Vera trace the patterns of the dust on the motel windowsill.
He kept a small, polished stone in his pocket to remind him of the coast.
He owed Bastian Kroll more than just the credits sitting on the table.
Silas wiped the oily residue of a faulty junction box onto his trousers after Vera walked past him.
He watched the blue sparks dance across the copper coil before the machine finally went quiet.
He owed Vera three more canisters of pressurized coolant from the last raid on the Ozone Station.
Maren watched Vera scrub the grease from a chipped saucer for ten minutes.
Maren left a single piece of broken porcelain on the diner counter.
Maren walked out into the heat without saying a word to anyone.
Bastian watched Vera polish the brass rails until her knuckles went white.
He tucked the heavy envelope of credits into his vest pocket after the meeting with Elias.
He bowed low to the empty lounge as if the shadows were applauding him.
